conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.field_frame: each clip starts at the origin facing the rig's forward direction; positions in metres: x = fielder's left (+) / right (-), y = forward is NEGATIVE y (toward the batter), so throw_target y=-30 is 30 m straight ahead
conventions.ball: attach the ball to mixamorig:RightHand from the pickup/catch/collect frame until the release/flick frame; then launch it from the hand toward throw_target at throw_speed (or with flick_velocity)
conventions.two_fielder_sequences: 30a+30b and 31a+31b are separate clips for each fielder, built in one shared field frame: play them at the same time with both characters placed at their start positions (sync notes in each clip)
conventions.root_motion: all travel is in the hips; end positions follow from the motion
